scope_note: OSW selects a broad offshore zonal section at 32 S and a peak-search window well offshore of the coastal Leeuwin system. Neither the section domain nor the peak-search window is a published West Australian Current boundary. The strongest eligible monthly northward component may represent an eddy or another flow; association with the named current remains unverified.
